column1: # What each refusal predicate of TegraGM20BMetalPredicates.h becomes once the planner decides before emission.
# fate: rule (a planner node rule or ladder rung covers it; covered_by names rules of plan_graph.h kRuleNames),
# client / query (validate() answers ClientError / QueryGated; covered_by names plan_validate.h kProblemNames),
# cb-error (the command buffer fails with MTLCommandBufferErrorDomain), gap (Metal allows it and no GPU-side rung exists
# yet: the work left before the slow backend can go), layer (owned below or above the planner: L3 resources, L4
# programs, L6 the Metal API), nil (L6 answers nil at creation, as Metal does for that descriptor), growth (a pool grows
# or the GPU work waits; never a refusal).

column5: note
a texture of another device: blitted, the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded (gm20bCallInvalid); bound, it fails Internal (gm20bBindTexture)
R1 (~1,400 HW Test cbs), R2, R3, R4 as tex.shape

levels, slices and depth planes of the textures the driver keeps, and levels of format views of mipmapped ones, are attachment targets (attachment_target.h), for attachments and resolves alike; left: a resolve into a texture the driver does not keep or render, a planar or YCbCr one, or a format with no resolve state, a resolve from a part of a texture, and what Metal's validation refuses (past the texture, a slice of a 3D texture or a plane of an array); renderTargetArrayLength past an attachment beside one drawn through work of the driver's own: the layers all have drawn, skipped at each making

Depth32Float beside Stencil8 (layered, from any slice) and one-sample Depth16Unorm beside Stencil8 render a Depth32Float_Stencil8 of theirs; a resolved pair resolves each aspect from its own texture, a multisampled Depth16Unorm converts a sample at a time; left: such a pair turned, a memoryless stencil resolved; a resolve or a store other than DontCare and Store the encoder decides with no resolve texture: its store kept or stored, skipped at each call
a turned attachment beside one of another rotation or size or a loaded or stored one not turned, a rotation-4 Load, and at encode a state whose turned variant could not be made (PipelineTurnRefused)
sample positions past the pass's samples: drawn at the standard ones, as Apple's driver, logged once
a render or depth/stencil state of another device, or no render state: the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded (gm20bCallInvalid)

Counting and Boolean results, reset or accumulated (visibility.h); left: what Metal's validation stops (no visibility buffer, an offset past it or taken twice in an encoder, a mode MTLVisibilityResultMode lacks)

a buffer of another device, or none, bound, drawn with, blitted, filled, copied, resolved into or executed with: the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded (gm20bCallInvalid; an indirect command's at its execute)

every sampler the device makes is raw's (opaque borders per sampled texture, Sampler::bordered); one it has no form of is nil at creation (gm20b:sampler.unsupported); left: a sampler of another device bound, and an opaque border header the pool has no slot for (the full-pool answer)
a copy or fill past its buffer: clamped to the bytes inside both, as Apple's driver copies (client_errors.h), skipped (counted), logged once a rule
a kernel's state, buffer, texture or sampler of another device: the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded (gm20bComputeFails)
no pack kernel at the dispatch's shape: a kernel record per shape
a texture sampled through an image of its own; the cropped-surface-view alias case is not tested
predication raw cannot run fails the command buffer: a misused record or a loop open where its unit ends; If/Else/End and loops run on render enable (predication.h, loop_copies.h)
MTLEvent waits and signals: Wait and Signal nodes (GPU semaphore acquire, release)
a sampler state's header under a planar texture's address map with no header entry left (a constexpr sampler's are placed with it, Device::constexprMapped_)
a planar target through its stand-in; sampled and rendered in one command buffer: its codes converted again after the store (edges order it)
a pass raw could not begin: resolve, YCbCr and extended-range targets are nodes with their rule decided before emission
the kernel refused the submission: a commit-time outcome, the command buffer's error (MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal)
an index type Metal has none of, indirect arguments past their buffer (read as zeros) or indices outside it (skipped), as Apple's driver, logged once
a state of the other four-channel 8-bit order drawn into the pass's format; another format skipped (Apple writes other bits), logged once
a texture with no header at the draw: every view gets its header slot when made
a state testing depth or stencil the pass lacks; shader-side tests (copyShaderTests) stay the pass's own work
a one-sample state in a pass of more writes sample 0, a many-sample one in a one-sample pass draws whole, as Apple's driver; others skipped, logged once
MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal
fetch ladder rung 4 for any geometry; the states with no storage form stay gap fetch_without_storage_form (11 on iOS 27, 53 on iOS 17 per x1-f1)
a fetched colour with neither form stays gap fetch_without_storage_form

a blit of this device's own objects Metal's validation stops: one an M4 Max crashes on or fails fails InvalidResource as it is recorded; one it runs nothing of or runs to no rule is skipped (counted, logged once a rule: c38-audit/failed-counts/probe/RESULTS.txt)

an indirect command buffer call Metal's validation stops: another device's or none executed, reset or copied, a reset past it, a command that sets a pipeline its buffer inherits or patches on a buffer of none (an M4 Max faults encoding it; at the execute that reaches it) fail InvalidResource; ranges past a buffer are cut to it, as an M4 Max runs them (skipped); a range off 4 bytes, render or compute, is read from the offset rounded down, as an M4 Max's GPU reads it, and one read past its buffer runs none, not mirrored: the GPU reads whatever lies past it (skipped both); an indexed command's indices off their type are read from the offset rounded down to it (skipped)

a counter sample buffer of another device, or a counter sample at an encoder's boundaries (an M4 Max aborts): InvalidResource as recorded; an invalid sample index, a nil sample buffer or a resolve range past the samples skipped, a resolve past its destination cut to it; a resolve into an offset off 4 bytes written there a byte at a time (skipped)

an untimed shared-event wait that held its queue's head for Metal's bound (5 s): MTLCommandBufferErrorTimeout with IOGPU's error under it, as Metal's GPU fails it; its writer promises withdrawn, the queue going on behind it
